integrity: The complete package includes a self-contained proof, explicit normalization and hypotheses, a reproducible symbolic and exact-arithmetic checker, candid limits, and a self-review C/O/V review. No independent mathematical audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results cover only finite connected simple unweighted biregular bipartite graph Laplacians, completed classical RK4 steps, and all nonnegative initial vectors; stagewise positivity, other numerical methods, weighted graphs, directed graphs, non-biregular graphs and disconnected graphs are not asserted. A specialized inaccessible or unindexed equivalent result could remain undiscovered.
title: Only complete biregular bicliques attain RK4 positivity up to spectral stability
